examples.en: I went to China with my parent.
examples.zh: 我和家长一起去了中国。

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is in China.
We took a tour in China.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：China 音近「chai 呐」，chai 呐代表中国 China。
形象联想：想象 China 中国地图上的 Sun Moon Lake。

examples.en: What did you do on the tour?
I did my homework before the trip.
We did many fun things at the lake.
examples.zh: 我们在湖边做了很多有趣的事。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What did you do? did 是 do 的过去式，做了。

reveal.inflectionNote: do 的过去式

examples.en: I went back to my hometown.
My hometown has a beautiful lake.
examples.zh: 我故乡有一个美丽的湖。

examples.en: We took a tour near my hometown.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hometown 音近「厚姆汤」，厚姆汤回 hometown 故乡。
语义联想：把「故乡」和英文 hometown 配对记忆。

examples.en: The lake is very beautiful.
We swam in the lake.
Sun Moon Lake is a famous lake.
examples.zh: 日月潭是一个著名的湖。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：lake 音近「雷克」，雷克在 lake 湖边。
形象联想：想象 Sun Moon Lake 日月潭的 lake 湖。

examples.en: My parent took me to the lake.
I went to China with my parent.
examples.zh: 我和家长一起去了中国。

examples.en: My parent was on the tour with me.
examples.zh: 我的家长和我一起旅行。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：parent 音近「佩润特」，佩润特是 parent 家长。
语义联想：把「父」和英文 parent 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 parents

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is in China.
We went to Sun Moon Lake last summer.
examples.zh: 我们去年夏天去了日月潭。

examples.en: I swam near Sun Moon Lake.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Sun 日 + Moon 月 + Lake 湖，Sun Moon Lake 是日月潭。

examples.en: I swam in the lake.
We swam near Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 我们在日月潭附近游泳。

examples.en: She swam with her parent.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：swam 音近「斯旺姆」，斯旺姆 swam 游泳。
语义联想：把「游泳（过去式）」和英文 swam 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: swim 的过去式

examples.en: We took a tour to Sun Moon Lake.
My parent took many photos.
examples.zh: 我的家长拍了很多照片。

examples.en: I took a boat on the lake.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We took a tour. took 是 take 的过去式，带了、拿了。

reveal.inflectionNote: take 的过去式

examples.en: We had a tour in China.
The tour to Sun Moon Lake was fun.
I went on a tour with my parent.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：tour 音近「图尔」，图尔去 tour 旅行。
语义联想：把「旅行」和英文 tour 配对记忆。

examples.en: I was in China last summer.
She was happy on the tour.
It was a beautiful lake.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I was in China. was 是 am/is 的过去式，曾经是。

reveal.inflectionNote: am/is 的过去式；复数过去式 were

examples.en: We went to Sun Moon Lake.
I went to my hometown.
They went on a tour in China.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We went to the lake. went 是 go 的过去式，去了。

reveal.inflectionNote: go 的过去式

examples.en: We were at Sun Moon Lake.
My parents were in my hometown.
They were tired after the tour.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We were at the lake. were 是 are 的过去式，曾是。

reveal.inflectionNote: are 的过去式

examples.en: Look at the animal!
We saw an animal at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我们在动物园看见很多动物。

examples.en: The elephant is a big animal.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 zoo 里各种 animal 动物。

examples.en: Do you have any food?
Are there any animals over there?
I did not see any elephants.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Do you have any food? any 是任何的。

examples.en: We ate lunch at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我们在动物园吃了午饭。

examples.en: The elephant ate grass.
I ate an apple when I was hungry.
examples.zh: 我饿的时候吃了一个苹果。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：ate 音近「埃特」，埃特 ate 吃了饭。
语义联想：把「吃（过去式）」和英文 ate 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: eat 的过去式

examples.en: Look at the elephant!
The elephant is over there.
We saw a big elephant at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我们在动物园看见一头大象。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：elephant 音近「艾里芳特」，艾里芳特是 elephant 大象。
形象联想：想象 elephant 大象在 zoo over there。

examples.en: There is a hill in the zoo.
We climbed the small hill.
The animal lives on the hill.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hill 音近「希欧」，希欧爬 hill 小山。
语义联想：把「小山」和英文 hill 配对记忆。

examples.en: The animal is hungry.
I am hungry. Can I eat?
We were hungry after the tour.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：hungry 音近「汉格瑞」，汉格瑞 feel hungry 饿了。
语义联想：看到「饿的」的事物时，就想到 hungry。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 hungrier；最高级 hungriest

examples.en: Look at the map of the zoo.
The elephant is on the map.
We found the hill on the map.
examples.zh: 我们在地图上找到了小山。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：map 音近「麦普」，麦普看 map 地图。
形象联想：想象 map 地图上标着 elephant 和 hill。

examples.en: The hill is next to the lake.
Sit next to me, please.
The elephant is next to the gate.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：next 下一个 + to 到，next to 是紧挨着。

examples.en: The elephant is over there.
Look! An animal is over there.
The hill is over there, next to the lake.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：over 越过 + there 那里，over there 是在那边。

examples.en: We saw an elephant at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我们在动物园看见一头大象。

examples.en: I saw a hungry animal over there.
examples.zh: 我在那边看见一只饿的动物。

examples.en: She saw the hill on the map.
examples.zh: 她在地图上看见了小山。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We saw an elephant. saw 是 see 的过去式，看见了。

reveal.inflectionNote: see 的过去式

examples.en: The cat is under the tree.
We saw animals under the hill.
examples.zh: 我们在小山下面看见了动物。

examples.en: Put the map under the book.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The cat is under the tree. under 是在……下面。

examples.en: They award the hero a medal.
examples.zh: 他们授予英雄一枚勋章。

examples.en: The doctor got an award.
She won an award for her work.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：They award the hero a medal. award 是授予、奖励。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 awards；过去式 awarded

examples.en: Doctors fight Covid-19.
examples.zh: 医生与新冠病毒作斗争。

examples.en: We learn about Covid-19 at school.
examples.zh: 我们在学校了解新冠病毒。

examples.en: Many heroes helped during Covid-19.
examples.zh: 许多英雄在疫情期间提供了帮助。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：COVID 冠状病毒 + 19 年，Covid-19 是新冠病毒。

examples.en: The doctor is a hero.
Dr. Li is a good doctor.
The doctor serves people every day.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：doctor 音近「道克特」，道克特是 doctor 医生。
语义联想：把「医生」和英文 doctor 配对记忆。

examples.en: Dr. Li is a hero.
We thank Dr. Zhong.
Dr. Wang is still at work.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Dr. Li is a hero. Dr. 是医生、博士。

examples.en: Doctors fight Covid-19.
examples.zh: 医生与新冠病毒作斗争。

examples.en: Heroes fight for our country.
We must fight hard together.
examples.zh: 我们必须一起努力斗争。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Doctors fight Covid-19. fight 是战斗、斗争。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 fights；过去式 fought

examples.en: I want to be a doctor when I grow up.
Heroes grow up and serve people.
examples.zh: 英雄们长大为人民服务。

examples.en: What do you want to do when you grow up?

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：grow 生长 + up 向上，grow up 是长大。

examples.en: Doctors work hard.
We must learn hard.
She fights hard against Covid-19.
examples.zh: 她与新冠病毒顽强斗争。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Work hard. hard 是努力地、努力的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 harder；最高级 hardest

examples.en: The doctor is a hero.
We learn about a hero in class.
She is a hero of our time.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 doctor 医生是 fight Covid-19 的 hero。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 heroes

examples.en: It is a great honor.
We honor our heroes.
The medal is an honor for the doctor.
examples.zh: 这枚勋章是医生的荣誉。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It is a great honor. honor 是荣誉。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 honors（英式 honour）

examples.en: We need more information.
This information is about our heroes.
examples.zh: 这条信息是关于我们的英雄的。

examples.en: Search for information about Dr. Zhong.
examples.zh: 搜索关于钟博士的信息。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We need information. information 是信息。

examples.en: We learn from heroes.
I learn hard at school.
Young Pioneers learn to serve people.
examples.zh: 少先队员学习为人民服务。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Learn from heroes. learn 是学习。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 learns；过去式 learned/learnt

examples.en: We love our heroes.
People love the doctors.
I love my country.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：love 音近「拉夫」，拉夫 love 爱。
语义联想：把「爱」和英文 love 配对记忆。

examples.en: He got the Medal of the Republic.
The Medal of the Republic is a great honor.
examples.zh: 共和国勋章是极高的荣誉。

examples.en: We learn about the Medal of the Republic.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Medal 勋章 + Republic 共和国，Medal of the Republic 是共和国勋章。

examples.en: She is a member of the team.
Every member works hard.
He is a member of the medical team.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She is a member of the team. member 是成员。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 members

examples.en: Many people love the heroes.
Doctors serve people.
People clap for the medical team.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Doctors serve people. people 是人、人们。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数仍为 people；表「民族」时为 peoples

examples.en: We search for information about heroes.
examples.zh: 我们搜索关于英雄的信息。

examples.en: Search for Covid-19 news online.
examples.zh: 在网上搜索新冠相关消息。

examples.en: I search for my homework on the internet.
examples.zh: 我在网上查找作业资料。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：search 搜索 + for 为了，search for 是搜索。

examples.en: Doctors serve people.
Heroes serve our country.
I want to serve people when I grow up.
examples.zh: 我长大后想为人民服务。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：serve 音近「瑟夫」，瑟夫 serve 服务。
语义联想：把「服务」和英文 serve 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 serves；过去式 served

examples.en: She is tired but still at work.
The doctor is still in the hospital.
We still love our heroes.
examples.zh: 我们仍然爱我们的英雄。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She is still at work. still 是还是、仍然。

examples.en: The medical team is a hero team.
Every team member works hard.
Our team won an award.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：team 音近「提姆」，提姆在 team 队里。
语义联想：把「（体育的）队」和英文 team 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 teams

examples.en: The doctors were very tired.
I feel tired after work.
She is tired but still at work.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：tired 音近「泰尔德」，泰尔德 feel tired 疲倦。
语义联想：看到「疲倦的」的事物时，就想到 tired。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 more tired

examples.en: The hero and his wife serve people.
examples.zh: 英雄和他的妻子为人民服务。

examples.en: Dr. Li and his wife are both doctors.
examples.zh: 李医生和他的妻子都是医生。

examples.en: His wife is a member of the team.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：wife 音近「外夫」，外夫和 wife 妻子。
语义联想：把「妻子」和英文 wife 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 复数 wives（不规则变化）

examples.en: Many women are heroes.
Women doctors fight Covid-19.
examples.zh: 女医生与新冠病毒作斗争。

examples.en: We honor women heroes.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Many women are heroes. women 是成年女子、妇女。

reveal.inflectionNote: woman 的复数形式

examples.en: I am a Young Pioneer.
Young Pioneers learn from heroes.
Every Young Pioneer should work hard.
examples.zh: 每个少先队员都应该努力。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：Young 少年 + Pioneer 先锋，Young Pioneer 是少先队员。

examples.en: I took my camera on the spring outing.
Take a photo with the camera.
She has a new camera.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：camera 音近「凯姆拉」，凯姆拉用 camera 拍照。
形象联想：想象 spring outing 用 camera 拍照。

examples.en: We climb the mountain.
Can you climb to the top?
I climb the hill on the spring outing.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We climb the mountain. climb 是攀爬。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 climbs；过去式 climbed

examples.en: There is a white cloud in the sky.
A cloud is on the mountain top.
Look at the cloud over there.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：cloud 音近「克劳德」，克劳德看 cloud 云。
形象联想：想象 white cloud 云在 sky 天空。

examples.en: We eat a meal at the farmhouse.
examples.zh: 我们在农舍吃了一顿饭。

examples.en: The farmhouse is in the village.
The hard-working family lives in the farmhouse.
examples.zh: 这户勤劳的人家住在农舍里。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 village 村里有 farmhouse 农舍。

examples.en: We meet at the school gate.
Get on the bus at the gate.
The gate of the village is open.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：gate 音近「盖特」，盖特从 gate 大门进。
语义联想：把「大门」和英文 gate 配对记忆。

examples.en: We get on the bus at the gate.
Get on the bus, please.
We get on the bus for our spring outing.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：get 上 + on 到……上，get on 是上车。

examples.en: The farmers are hard-working.
She is a hard-working student.
Hard-working people grow good food.
examples.zh: 勤劳的人们种出好粮食。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：hard 努力 + working 工作，hard-working 是努力工作的。

examples.en: We had a big meal at the farmhouse.
examples.zh: 我们在农舍吃了一顿大餐。

examples.en: The meal was really good.
We eat a meal after climbing.
examples.zh: 爬山后我们吃了一顿饭。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：meal 音近「米尔」，米尔吃 meal 一顿饭。
语义联想：把「一顿饭」和英文 meal 配对记忆。

examples.en: The mountain is very high.
We climb the mountain together.
There are clouds on the mountain top.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：mountain 音近「毛恩腾」，毛恩腾爬 mountain 山。
形象联想：想象 spring outing 爬 mountain 山到 top 顶部。

examples.en: We pick flowers in the village.
Pick an apple from the tree.
Do not pick flowers in the park.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：pick 音近「皮克」，皮克 pick 摘苹果。
语义联想：把「采」和英文 pick 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 picks；过去式 picked

examples.en: The spring outing was really fun.
I am really thirsty.
The mountain is really high.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：It was really fun. really 是确实地、的确。

examples.en: The sky is blue today.
Look at the clouds in the sky.
The sky is beautiful on the mountain.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：sky 音近「斯凯」，斯凯看 sky 天空。
语义联想：把「天空」和英文 sky 配对记忆。

examples.en: We had a spring outing yesterday.
Our spring outing was fun.
We climb mountains on the spring outing.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：spring 春 + outing 外出，spring outing 是春游。

examples.en: I am thirsty after climbing.
We were thirsty on the mountain.
Drink water when you are thirsty.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I am thirsty. thirsty 是渴的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 thirstier；最高级 thirstiest

examples.en: We climb to the top of the mountain.
The view from the top is great.
Clouds are on the top of the hill.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：We climbed to the top of the mountain. top 是顶部。

examples.en: We visit a small village.
The village is near the mountain.
There is a farmhouse in the village.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：village 音近「维里奇」，维里奇 visit village 村庄。
语义联想：把「乡村」和英文 village 配对记忆。

examples.en: I need some water.
We drink water on the mountain.
The lake has clean water.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：water 音近「沃特」，沃特喝 water 水。
语义联想：把「水」和英文 water 配对记忆。

examples.en: Sports Day is very busy.
We are busy on Sports Day.
The teachers are busy today.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Sports Day is busy. busy 是忙的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 busier；最高级 busiest

examples.en: Be careful! Do not fall down.
He fell down but got up.
Try again if you fall down.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：fall 跌倒 + down 向下，fall down 是跌倒。

examples.en: Run fast!
He runs very fast.
She is fast in the race.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：fast 音近「法斯特」，法斯特 run fast 跑得很快。
语义联想：Run fast! fast 是快地、快的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 faster；最高级 fastest

examples.en: We ran on the grass.
Sit on the grass, please.
The grass is green on Sports Day.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 Sports Day 在 green grass 上跑步。

examples.en: He tries the high jump.
The high jump is difficult.
We shout for the high jump.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：high 高 + jump 跳，high jump 是跳高。

examples.en: I try the long jump.
She is good at the long jump.
The long jump is on Sports Day.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：long 远 + jump 跳，long jump 是跳远。

examples.en: The race is one hundred meter long.
He ran fifty meter fast.
The long jump is three meter.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：meter 音近「米特」，米特量 meter 米。
语义联想：把「米」和英文 meter 配对记忆。

examples.en: I am proud of our team.
examples.zh: 我为我们的队感到自豪。

examples.en: My parent is proud of me.
examples.zh: 我的家长为我感到骄傲。

examples.en: We are proud of the winner.
examples.zh: 我们为获胜者感到自豪。

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：proud 音近「普劳德」，普劳德 feel proud 自豪。
语义联想：看到「自豪的」的事物时，就想到 proud。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 prouder；最高级 proudest

examples.en: I ran fast in the race.
He ran one hundred meters.
We ran on the grass.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：ran 音近「润」，润 ran 跑过终点。
语义联想：把「跑（过去式）」和英文 ran 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: run 的过去式

examples.en: We shout for our team.
examples.zh: 我们为自己的队喊加油。

examples.en: Do not shout in class.
They shout "Go! Go!" on Sports Day.
examples.zh: 运动会上他们喊"加油！加油！"

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：shout 音近「绍特」，绍特 shout 喊叫。
语义联想：把「喊叫」和英文 shout 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 shouts；过去式 shouted

examples.en: Today is our Sports Day.
We have races on Sports Day.
Sports Day is busy and fun.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：sports 运动 + day 日，Sports Day 是运动会。

examples.en: Try the high jump!
I try my best on Sports Day.
Try again if you fall down.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：try 音近「揣」，揣一 try 试一试。
语义联想：把「尝试」和英文 try 配对记忆。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 tries；过去式 tried

examples.en: She jumps very well.
You did well on Sports Day.
examples.zh: 你在运动会上表现得很好。

examples.en: He runs fast and well.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：well 音近「威尔」，威尔 do well 做得好。
语义联想：把「好」和英文 well 配对记忆。

examples.en: Do not be angry.
He is angry about the race.
She looks angry but not sad.
examples.zh: 她看起来生气但并不难过。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Do not be angry. angry 是生气的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 angrier；最高级 angriest

examples.en: Cheer up! You did well.
examples.zh: 振作起来！你表现得很好。

examples.en: Cheer up! Try again next time.
We cheer up our sad friend.
examples.zh: 我们让难过的好友振作起来。

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：cheer 欢呼 + up 起来，cheer up 是振作起来。

examples.en: Drink some water after the race.
I drink water when I am thirsty.
Do not drink too fast.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Drink some water. drink 是喝。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 drinks；过去式 drank

examples.en: She came first in the race.
I was first on Sports Day.
First place is great!

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：She came first. first 是第一。

examples.en: He came fourth in the race.
Fourth is still good.
I was fourth on Sports Day.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He came fourth. fourth 是第四。

examples.en: I only came fourth.
She is only a little sad.
We have only one race left.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I only came fourth. only 是仅仅。

examples.en: The program is on TV tonight.
We watch a program after dinner.
The Sports Day program is fun.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Watch a program. program 是节目。

examples.en: The race starts now.
I am in the race.
Who won the race?

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：race 音近「瑞斯」，瑞斯 run a race 赛跑。
形象联想：想象 Sports Day 上 run a race 赛跑。

reveal.inflectionNote: 第三人称单数 races；过去式 raced

examples.en: He is sad because he lost the race.
examples.zh: 他因为输了赛跑而难过。

examples.en: Do not be sad.
She looks sad today.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：sad 音近「赛的」，赛的 feel sad 感到难过。
语义联想：看到「难过的」的事物时，就想到 sad。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 sadder；最高级 saddest

examples.en: He came second in the race.
Second is also good.
She was second on Sports Day.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：He came second. second 是第二。

examples.en: Our team came third.
Third place is not bad.
He finished third in the race.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Our team came third. third 是第三。

examples.en: My grandfather also lives here.
We also visit our neighbor.
She is on the twelfth floor and also on the fifteenth.
examples.zh: 她在第十二层，也在第十五层。

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My grandfather also lives here. also 是也。

examples.en: There is a bridge over the river.
We walk on the bridge.
The bridge is near our building.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 bridge 桥横跨 river 河。

examples.en: Our school building is tall.
The building has twelve floors.
There is a bridge near the building.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 tall building 有很多 floor 楼层。

examples.en: The fifteenth floor is very high.
Fifteenth comes after fourteenth.
Our neighbor lives on the fifteenth floor.
examples.zh: 我们的邻居住在第十五层。

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 fifteenth 第十五 的名次牌，边指边记住它。

examples.en: Our classroom is on the third floor.
Which floor is the living room on?
The building has one floor for our class.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Which floor? floor 是楼层。

examples.en: My grandfather also lives here.
Grandfather walks on the bridge.
I visit my grandfather every week.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My grandfather lives here. grandfather 是祖父、外公。

examples.en: My grandmother lives with us.
examples.zh: 我祖母和我们住在一起。

examples.en: Grandmother sits in the living room.
I love my grandmother.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：My grandmother sits here. grandmother 是祖母、外婆。

examples.en: We watch TV in the living room.
The living room is on the second floor.
My grandmother sits in the living room.

mnemonic.text: 拆词联想：living 生活 + room 房间，living room 是客厅。

examples.en: Our neighbor is very kind.
I visit my neighbor after school.
The neighbor lives on the fifteenth floor.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Our neighbor is kind. neighbor 是邻居。

examples.en: There is a river near our building.
examples.zh: 我们建筑物附近有一条河。

examples.en: We walk by the river.
The bridge is over the river.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 river 河上有 bridge 桥。

examples.en: My classroom is on the twelfth floor.
Twelfth is after eleventh.
The twelfth floor has a big window.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：The twelfth floor. twelfth 是第十二。

examples.en: I would like to visit the river.
Would you like to see the bridge?
We would like to meet our neighbor.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：I would like to visit. would 是会、愿意。

examples.en: Wash your hands before dinner.
Before Sports Day, we practice hard.
examples.zh: 运动会前我们努力练习。

examples.en: Guess before you look at the calendar.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Wash hands before dinner. before 是在……之前。

examples.en: Look at the calendar.
The date is on the calendar.
Circle the date on the calendar.

mnemonic.text: 形象联想：想象 calendar 日历上圈出 date 日期。

examples.en: What is the date today?
Write the date on your book.
The date is on the calendar.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：What is the date today? date 是日期。

examples.en: This question is difficult.
It is difficult to guess the date.
Math is difficult for me.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：This is difficult. difficult 是困难的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 more difficult；最高级 most difficult

examples.en: Guess the date!
Can you guess the answer?
Guess what is on the calendar.

mnemonic.text:
谐音联想：guess 音近「盖斯」，盖斯 guess 猜一猜。
语义联想：把「猜」和英文 guess 配对记忆。

examples.en: You are lucky today!
I feel lucky on my birthday.
examples.zh: 生日那天我感到很幸运。

examples.en: Guess my lucky number!

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：You are lucky! lucky 是幸运的。

reveal.inflectionNote: 比较级 luckier；最高级 luckiest

examples.en: Good morning, Mrs. Wang!
Mrs. Li is our neighbor.
Say hello to Mrs. Chen.

mnemonic.text: 语义联想：Good morning, Mrs. Wang! Mrs. 是夫人、太太。
